# GTA VI Companion — Catalog maintenance and reconciliation

This document records internal source comparisons, unresolved identity matches, progress-ID decisions and historical research notes. These are not verified gameplay claims.

## Stunt jump illustrated-route crosswalk — November 27, 2026

Source: [PowerPyx illustrated route](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-stunt-jump-locations/). All 130 supplied stunt records matched by name, with one spelling normalization. Two county assignments differ from the archive; the app menu grouping, saved IDs and row order are unchanged. Guide numbers are navigation indexes, not in-game IDs. **Questline trophy audit (2.0.1):** The eight qualifying strands are Merle, Freddie, Kirk, Kyle, Alvan, Yago, Papa Audacity and Pilot Pete; credit is awarded at the finale. The [PowerPyx index](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-strangers-freaks-side-missions/) and [GTABase roster](https://www.gtabase.com/gta-6/strangers-missions/) agree on this list. Timed errands are distinct from trophy requirements. New November 27 walkthroughs identify [three ATM targets](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-yasmanis-atm-jobs-walkthrough/), the optional [Gold Blammer](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-yasmani-steal-the-gold-blammer-walkthrough/) and [small-bank tips](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-yasmanis-bank-jobs-walkthrough/). The latter two may be skipped by progressing to the Chapter 4 vault tutorial; the ATM tip expires after one in-game day. These are documented under existing mission entries, not assigned new progress IDs. The complete game mission roster is broader than the 43-entry checklist.

**Special Weapons reconciliation (2.0.1):** All 94 named entries in the [PowerPyx 130-slot roster](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-weapons/) already map to existing IDs; its remaining 36 entries are unnamed, not 36 proven missing variants. All 24 entries in the [GTA Top free-find and mission guide](https://gta-top.com/en/gta-6/unique-weapons) and all 24 items in the [Palm Underworld retailer table](https://www.gtavl.com/news/gta-6-unique-weapons/) match existing catalog records. These bounded roster checks are complete. Targeted guide references are not new GPS pins. The [November 27 GTA6GPS directory](https://gta6gps.com/map/game/weapon-variants) supplies 25 additional named marker URLs after collision checks. The 137 entries include ordinary weapon pickups: PowerPyx lists the H-AT, GLR40 and Hawk & Little Morgan as standard weapons. Unnamed markers, disputed variant spellings, and store restrictions remain provisional. GTABase's JavaScript-rendered 115-marker list is not individually accessible, so that directory is not declared complete. No new IDs were assigned.

## November 26 research follow-up (2.0.1)

- [Delivery Day](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-delivery-day-meet-randy-walkthrough/) and [Collect the Tempesta](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-collect-the-tempesta-walkthrough/): final wishlist sequence, trophy, follow-up garage, registration and resale terms. Domestic Timbers is a reference-only garage lead, not a new checklist identity.
- [Kenton sets](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-kenton-sets-locations-search-the-dive-sites/) and [Maritime Dispute](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-maritime-dispute-stop-by-kentons-shop-walkthrough/): batch progression, contact tracker, late dive unlocks and unresolved discovery overlap for Belpoint/Bobcat. [Fish roster](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-fish-fishing/): study versus catch credit.
- [Frampton bunker](https://lootradar.net/secrets/frampton-island-bunker-code-3612), [alternate report](https://gta6.house/guides/gta-6-frampton-island-bunker-code), [robot warehouse](https://lootradar.net/easter-eggs/decor-district-robot-doll-warehouse), [Chase rescue](https://lootradar.net/easter-eggs/furry-rescue-chase-fox-furry-dw-9), [alternate Chase cash report](https://gta6.house/library/characters/chase), [Casanova watch](https://lootradar.net/loot/crowex-octane-kaleidoscope-rainbow-watch-casanova-island), [Freddie retest](https://lootradar.net/secrets/unlock-hurricanes-freddie-bunker-north-leonard-county) and [relationship tip](https://lootradar.net/tips/open-car-door-for-lucia-relationship): reported routes and conditions; no independent game verification.
- Nine individual [GTA6GPS Standout maps](https://gta6gps.com/map/game/standout-vehicles) were matched to existing records. Three candidate pins (918847, 918200, 918701) were withheld because the existing catalog already associates them with other identities or locations; no remapping without reconciliation. All progress IDs and ranges retained.

### Additional vehicle and watch reconciliation

- [GTA6GPS unique vehicle directory](https://gta6gps.com/map/game/unique-vehicles): 8 newly matched individual NFC pins, revised acquisition clues and map coordinates. Existing conflicting location leads retained without reassignment.
- [Vice City Hustle watches](https://www.vicecityhustle.com/guides/gta-6-luxury-watches) and [GTA6 Maps watches](https://gta6-maps.net/categories/luxury-watches): alternate pickup reports, wardrobe credit and minimum watch requirement. Named markers are not necessarily distinct collection slots.

### Card identification and pet menu reconciliation

- [AllThingsHow card table](https://allthings.how/gta-6-collectible-cards-list/) (Nov 26): reported printed player positions, baseball AVG, family categories, artwork subjects and contestant years. Player-level metadata applies to existing color variants; no extra card identities or locations implied. Junior/Tusi Taufua and other differing names remain unresolved; no automatic rename.
- [Nexzy Flamingos](https://www.nexzyapp.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/guide/vice-city-flamingos-cards), [Penetrators](https://www.nexzyapp.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/guide/liberty-city-penetrators-cards), [Wrath](https://www.nexzyapp.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/guide/liberty-city-wrath-cards), [Backyard Wrestling](https://www.nexzyapp.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/guide/bam-backyard-wrestling-cards): selected photo-based access clues and alternate reports. No new progress IDs.
- [PowerPyx Cats & Dogs](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-cats-dogs/) (Nov 26): 34 menu positions. Random residential spawns do not resolve the remaining three cat-specific encounter gaps; unusual-animal locations still need independent confirmation.
- Additional PowerPyx menu-order references: [Hunting](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-hunting-animals/), [Fishing](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-fish-fishing/), [Birds](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-birds/), [Mammals](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-mammals/), [Aquatic](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-aquatic-animals/), [Reptiles and amphibians](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-reptiles-amphibians/). Exact name matches only; differences in the published roster do not create extra animals. Menu slots locate a missing entry in the game, not its world spawn.

- [FindLeonida card directory](https://findleonida.com/en/collectibles/trading-cards/) (Nov 26): 79 additional item-specific alternate map references, matched by name, variant and pickup clue. The directory marks 391 of its 480 locations as not checked in-game; these are labeled separately. Existing locations and checkmarks are retained.
- [PC Gamer Missing Persons walkthrough](https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-missing-persons-locations/) and [GTA6Maps.wiki](https://gta6maps.wiki/gta-6-missing-tourists-locations/): Chapter 1 warehouse lead, victim landmarks, Chapter 2 completion and paired-branch glasses reward. [ViceVaulted tracker](https://www.vicevaulted.com/tracker): November 25 exploit recheck; no independent user tests recorded.

Research cross-checks: [GTA6Ops flamingo video routes](https://gta6ops.com/collectibles/cocaine-flamingos/), [WikiGTAVI watch directory](https://www.wikigtavi.com/map/luxury-watches), [GTA6HelpHub watches](https://gta6helphub.com/guides/gta-6-collectible-watches/), and [Output Lag hunting](https://outputlag.com/guides/gta-6-hunting-bret-vogel/).

- [Card Hunt Delights Dancers](https://cardhuntgta.com/cards/delights-dancers): all 18/18 standard-card identities and reported pickup descriptions reconciled; each has its own guide link where link capacity permits. Vicki has player-reported confirmation at Starlet Motel; others remain guide-reported. [Jack of Hearts](https://cardhuntgta.com/cards/jack-of-hearts-dancers) supplies additional precise pickup landmarks.

**Dancer-set reconciliation:** All 90 dancer-card identities have reported pickup directions and individual timestamped video references (Delights 18/18, Jack of Hearts 36/36, Nine1Nine 36/36). [Jack of Hearts](https://cardhuntgta.com/cards/jack-of-hearts-dancers) lists 36 locations; [Nine1Nine](https://cardhuntgta.com/cards/nine1nine-dancers) lists 35, with [Meghan Silver](https://warppipes.com/en/gta-6/nine1nine-cards/n919-meghan-silver) covered independently at Waning Sands. [Jack of Hearts route](https://gta6ops.com/collectibles/jack-of-hearts-dancers-cards/) and [Nine1Nine route](https://gta6ops.com/collectibles/nine1nine-dancers-cards/) clarify safe and variant access. Catalog coverage is complete; conflicting alternate sightings and actual collection credit remain subject to gameplay verification.

- **Smokescreen Carbon RS:** Port Gellhorn building-site container; Race Bikes; speed 7, acceleration 8, handling 7.6. Not Hung Carbon RS.
- **Bullion Gauntlet:** Millport cargo container; Ripped & Shredded.
- **Beast Chino:** Lake Tallaloko luxury resort; Retro; exact parking spot not verified.
- **Dogfight FCR:** VCIA flight school; Retro; aviation styling, not Booty FCR 1000.
- **Obsidian Sovereign:** Draper Island shipping container; Retro; not Peacock or Blood Fever.
- **Raul's Coquette Classic:** Ocean Beach marina; Retro; distinct from ordinary 1964 Coquette in published variant lists.
- **AudaCity Sanchez:** Chapter 3 Trial by Tire, La Perle parking garage; use during mission, retention not verified.
- **AudaCity Sandking:** Chapter 3 Quit Your Job, Sell Your House; after hospital drop-off keep or sell. Alternate Vice City Sign stunt: Key Cloner, alarm, no tracker. Reported registration $4,400.
- **Interdimensional Youga:** Abandoned in Mount Kalaga National Park; Fine Art; separate from Third Eye at Grayson.
- **Lacewing Maverick:** Crosstown rooftop; Law & Order; exact roof access not verified.
- **Independence Boomazoom:** Bar by Lake Leonida; Americana-style livery; exact bar unverified.
- **Sandblasted Cliffhanger:** Breakwater Quarry container corroborated by GTABase and GTA Town; All-Terrain; distinct from Magma.
- **Chrome Street Blazer:** Roadside cargo crate, Port Gellhorn; All-Terrain; distinct from Azalea and Tormentor.

## Documentation consolidation — November 27, 2026

The following previous README material is retained for catalog maintenance and historical traceability. Counts and source claims are snapshots; the user-facing README and actual TSV catalogs take precedence.

### Memory usage and installation

Quick Guide and gameplay reference text are loaded from `assets/catalogs/guide_sections.tsv` (title, mode, body, zero-based first wildlife row, count), `wildlife.tsv` (page title, animal name, encounter/equipment/identification notes), and `guide_misc.tsv` (key, title, body). The 60-topic guide menu reads the topic titles from storage, loads only the selected topic and at most 16 wildlife rows, and releases temporary records/indexes. The collection progress page calculates live saved progress from `progress_ranges.tsv` (inclusive sorted first/last ID ranges, regenerate when catalog IDs change); the money guide uses the existing warehouse URL in `links_00.tsv`. Escapes `\\`, `\n`, `\t` and `\r` are decoded by the shared TSV loader. Collection and vehicle detail rows use the same escape decoding; escaped paragraph breaks display as actual line breaks. Preserve row order or update guide ranges when adding/reordering wildlife entries. Secret mission navigation links are in `secret_map_targets.tsv` (secret ID, collection asset, collection ID). The optional eighth field in `cheats.tsv` holds single-source inputs such as Pinhole separately from platform input fields. Menu routing, controller behavior, save layout, collection group synchronization and structural catalog descriptors remain code. Missing or malformed guide assets report unavailable rather than requiring a compiled-in copy.

### Memory usage and installation

Catalogs use UTF-8 TSV files without headers or a byte-order mark. Preserve progress IDs and unique keys in the NFC link catalogs. Item links are partitioned into `assets/catalogs/links_NN.tsv`, where `NN` is the zero-padded decimal result of dividing the item ID by 256 (integer division). Only nonempty partitions need to exist. Each lookup scans the item’s partition; category fallback remains in `link_categories.tsv`. Optional `links_extra_NN.tsv` partitions add up to eight labeled URLs per item without changing the six-column legacy format. Each extra row contains nine tab-separated fields: `id`, then four `label` / `url` pairs. Pad unused pairs with empty fields. If the first row contains four URLs, a second row keyed `id:2` may supply four more. Labels describe the location or purpose; the app adds the provider name. Exact duplicate URLs are merged, retaining a supplied location label. A shared GTA6GPS category map is offered first when no item-specific GTA6GPS reference exists. Remove the obsolete monolithic `assets/catalogs/links.tsv` when upgrading the source tree. Enable `GTA_RAM_DIAGNOSTICS` to log free heap, minimum free heap, the largest free heap block, and the app task's unused stack watermark.

### Catalog reference coverage

The [WikiGTAVI collectible card map directory](https://www.wikigtavi.com/map/collectible-cards) offers numbered location listings for named cards, including possible alternate pickups. Individual NFC directory references open the corresponding list entry when supported by the browser; use its numbered row to locate the map marker. Verify the card name and grade before marking progress.

The item-level NFC catalogs contain **10,150 distinct item-to-URL associations across 2,877 linked IDs**, excluding repeated copies of the same URL for an item. Shared venue maps and guide references can legitimately apply to multiple items; this is not a count of unique pickup locations. Category fallback links are separate.

- **Cards and vehicles:** All 480 named cards across 18 sets and 282 Standout Vehicle entries have item-level references; 17 additional named variants have published guide references. Sources include [GTA6Wiki collectible cards](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/collectible-card/), [FindLeonida trading cards](https://findleonida.com/en/collectibles/trading-cards/), [GTADB card guides](https://gtadb.net/articles/gta-6-collectible-cards-locations-guide/) and [GTA Town Standout Cars](https://gtatown.com/map/standout-cars). FindLeonida positions are estimates. Nine1Nine's Jesina Gold is also spelled Jesenia in GTA6Wiki; this is the same tracked identity pending in-game verification.
- **Stunts and WAiNK:** All 397 stunts and all 89 WAiNK landmarks, curiosities and sculptures have item-level references. Named alternate maps are available for 202 [bridge crossings](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/under-the-bridge/), 129 of 130 [stunt jumps](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/stunt-jump/), 40 [knife flights](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/knife-flight/), 25 [BASE jumps](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/base-jump/) and all 89 WAiNK [landmarks](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/waink-landmark/), [curiosities](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/waink-curiosity/) and [sculptures](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/waink-sculpture/). The Southpoint Airfield / LTF Airfield alternate-map match remains unresolved. Each bridge also has a numbered [WikiGTAVI map-directory reference](https://www.wikigtavi.com/map/under-the-bridge); select its named row to open the map card. County grouping can differ between guides, so use the named crossing rather than the directory region.
- **Activities and robberies:** Item-level references cover all 42 drone trials, 35 smash and grabs, 39 gang operations, 40 unique races, 13 race challenges, 7 book swaps, 7 pool opponents, 18 meditation completions and 27 publications. [GTA6Wiki map categories](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/) include alternate course and venue maps; some references point to a shared site or named guide rather than an exact pickup pin.

### County coverage

Item notes identify the reported county where an existing location names an unambiguous area, using the [in-game region and sub-region directory](https://thegameswiki.com/gta6/wiki/map-and-regions) and [Leonida geography guide](https://gta6versity.com/en/guides/gta-6-map-locations). County labels support geographic searches, including the card challenge across the five counties. They describe the reported area, not independently surveyed pickup coordinates; conflicting, ambiguous and boundary locations are left unassigned. Provisional leads retain their original status.

### Area sweep references

Individual checklist and vehicle notes include cross-catalog references to other named entries in the same reported district or landmark. These are planning aids based on existing catalog locations, not measured distances, guaranteed nearby spawns, new map pins or shared collection credit. A shared source marker can represent a venue, not the same objective. Follow each entry’s own access and completion conditions. Card notes include [published progress-list positions](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-collectible-card-sets-locations/) where the identity can be matched, and explicitly flag uncertain grades or conflicting reports. Selected cards list sibling grades with their catalog IDs; each grade is a separate collection entry, not another pickup of the same card. Existing IDs and original variant labels are preserved. [Additional reported slot evidence](https://gta.exputer.com/gta-6/collectibles/collectible-card-locations/) is identified in individual notes.

### Detailed v2.0.1 release history (before consolidation)

- Added overall performance tiers for 142 named Standout Vehicles, published top-ten rankings, and additional visual and access clues for 10 numbered AHOL artworks; preserved all existing item map links and progress IDs.
- Expanded named card location references and alternate pickup clues across the card sets, preserving existing progress IDs and distinguishing directory markers from unique card identities.
- Added numbered alternate map-directory references for all 202 bridge crossings, including the disputed Balsero Overpass North; expanded Randy vehicle scan and alternate acquisition notes, and clarified submarine marker offsets. Preserved existing progress IDs and map links.

## Peewees and No Flusher collection audit — November 27, 2026

All four existing Peewees IDs (1368–1371) matched the published routes by county and highway. Added facing and approach instructions and the final prize workflow. Games.gg and GTA Walkthrough agree on west-facing scans in Vice-Dale and Mariana, north-facing scans in Leonard and Lummox. Push Square places the Mariana sign west of Richardson Hunting Supplies; Cutscene Wire says east. Both place it in the US-82 median, so no location ID or existing map was changed. Insider Gaming provides additional road-sign landmarks. The collection was already numerically complete; this update completes the previously missing walkthrough fields rather than discovering four new billboards.

All 15 No Flusher IDs (1344–1358) match the Findora/IGN landmark directory. The GTA6.house quest guide reports ten of the 15 scans advance the quest, and describes ten Ocean Beach stops. The existing Ocean Beach route is preserved while the notes distinguish the collection count and quest threshold. No proof of a mandatory fixed ten-tag subset was found. No additional GPS links were added.

Bret's Target Decks: Leonida Tracks still lists decks 4–15 without a complete species roster; the archive already contains partial deck 4 evidence. Luxury watches: the 25-marker WikiGTAVI directory has alternate copies and unnamed pickups, while the 34-location video index provides no item-by-item textual roster. Full watch and deck identity completion remains blocked; no new IDs allocated. The source links are retained in more_sources.md.

Validation scope: static source archive, TSV identity/field checks and ZIP integrity. No firmware compilation, physical Flipper test or gameplay verification.
